commitments.detail: The memorial will be held at Willow Point, as Grandma requested in her handwritten note.
We will use the north paved trail to reach Willow Point, avoiding the steep south path for Ruth's safety.
The ceremony will begin at 10:00 AM on the planned Saturday, within the county ranger's permitted window of 10:00–12:00 for placing ashes at Willow Point.
The ashes will be transferred from the temporary plastic container into a water-soluble urn before the water ceremony.
The short dedication will use Grandma's requested words: 'Love keeps finding its way home.'
